recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless a future compatibility-map review specifically revisits historical conversion aliases.
issue_request: FHIR-3126 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for DSTU1 asking to rename Questionnaire Group.header to Group.title, with comments recording PC approval on 2014-05-29.
initial_application: No commit explicitly naming FHIR-3126 was found, but commit 54ddc30bbb changed Questionnaire.group.header to Questionnaire.group.title and changed the wording from text displayed above group contents to a name displayed for the group. The same DSTU1-era change split QuestionnaireAnswers out and introduced QuestionnaireAnswers.group.title alongside QuestionnaireAnswers.group.text.
additional_context: FHIR-8986 later approved merging Questionnaire group and question into recursive Questionnaire.item. Commit 52dbc1c478 applied that later change, replacing Questionnaire.group.title with Questionnaire.item.text and QuestionnaireResponse.group.title with QuestionnaireResponse.item.text. Current fhir.ini keeps Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse active, and current source has no live Questionnaire.group.header element.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current core source already differentiates group section labels from detailed display/instruction text through Questionnaire.item.text and the Questionnaire notes, so another source edit would be redundant and could conflict with later approved model refactoring.

related_jiras.note: Published Questionnaire refactoring merged group/question into recursive Questionnaire.item and explains why the current build no longer has Group.header or Group.title elements.
